decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records that additional branding, industrial-design, and cosmetic refinement will occur separately after receipt of the functional prototype.

The existing DEFER records the lifecycle decision but omits the client-established timing that the additional industrial-design and cosmetic refinement is separate work after receipt of the functional prototype.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Larry,

Thank you for the update.

After reviewing our original project discussions and scope, I understand that the initial focus was primarily on the engineering, wiring, circuitry, prototyping, and functionality of the machine. As the project evolved, I became more focused on the aesthetic and branding aspects, but I can see how the original scope was centered more heavily on developing a functional prototype.

My primary concern at this point is ensuring that the machine is mechanically sound, reliable, and operates as intended. Functionality and performance are my highest priorities.

I would like to see the demonstration of the prototype as soon as it is available. Please include the machine operating under normal use conditions so I can evaluate the mixing performance, stability, and overall functionality.

Once I receive and review the demonstration, I would like to move forward with completing the remaining wiring, enclosure fabrication, and base fabrication so that the machine can be shipped.

Regarding aesthetics, I appreciate your willingness to incorporate the "K" button markings and discuss lighting options. I will likely pursue additional branding, industrial design, and cosmetic refinements separately after receiving the prototype, so my immediate focus is on getting a fully functioning machine completed and delivered.

Please provide the demonstration and an updated target ship date once the remaining work is complete.

value_updates.additional_visual_refinement_timing: separate work after receipt of the functional prototype

decisions.reason: The existing same-message DEFER records that decorative lighting is not part of the immediate functional-prototype priority, but it omits the stated timing for later cosmetic refinement.

The source allows K button markings to remain under discussion while moving additional industrial-design and cosmetic refinement later, so it is unclear which existing DJ-style controls are affected.
The timing of additional branding and cosmetic refinement does not change the already approved component set or BOM obligations.
The source branding-timing change does not alter the platform's required height, cup clearance, configuration, or mixer fit.
Deferring additional branding and cosmetic refinement does not change any cleaning, sanitation, or fluid-path requirement.
The source decision changes the timing of additional aesthetic refinement, not the finalized system-layout or CAD deliverable.
The source decision does not modify the wiring-plan deliverable; references to completing physical wiring concern build work rather than this documentation requirement.
The timing change for additional branding and cosmetic refinement does not alter the approved bowl capacity or form.
The source does not change the spout's construction, geometry, downward pour direction, barista orientation, or beverage-quality constraints.
